name: odeget
expr: rt = odeget(o, 'RelTol'); at = odeget(o, 'abstol'); ms = odeget(o, 'MaxStep'); jp = odeget(o, 'Jacobian', 42);
covers: odeget(opts, name, default)      fall back to default when field empty
comment: Sig 1+2: odeget(o, 'RelTol') and odeget(o, name, default). MATLAB normalises name to canonical capitalisation, returns the stored value if non-empty, else the default. Empty Jacobian field falls through to 42 here.
